inputs.name: eta
inputs.tooltip:
Stochastic strength of reverse-time SDE.
When eta=0, it reduces to deterministic ODE. This setting doesn't apply to ER-SDE solver type.

inputs.name: s_noise
inputs.tooltip: Per-step noise multiplier at the first step (1.0 = match training).

inputs.name: s_noise_end
inputs.tooltip: Per-step noise multiplier at the last step. Set equal to s_noise for a constant schedule.

inputs.name: noise_clip_std
inputs.tooltip: Clamp per-step noise to +/- N*std. 0 disables.

presentation.description: LCM sampler with tunable per-step noise. s_noise is a multiplier on the model's training noise scale
